transcript: Northwind Labs leave policy, version 4. Replaces version 3. Effective 1 July 2026. Full-time staff get 22 days of paid leave per year. Unused days do not carry over.

decisions.statement: Northwind Labs full-time staff receive 22 days of paid leave per year under leave policy version 4.
quotes: Full-time staff get 22 days of paid leave per year.

decisions.statement: Northwind Labs unused paid leave days do not carry over under leave policy version 4.
quotes: Unused days do not carry over.
